title: Simultaneous ingroup and outgroup favoritism in implicit social cognition

focal_claim.text: On indirect measures focusing on positive valence, members of non-dominant racial groups showed ingroup favoritism. (p. 275.)

reported.statistic: MC-IAT White-Black associations among black participants: good N = 856, bad N = 751, Good-focal = −0.12 (0.60), Bad-focal = 0.16 (0.64), t = 9.01, p < .001, d [95% CI] = 0.45 [0.35, 0.55]

focal_claim.note: Multi100 coded the claim as a one-sample t of the good-focal BIAT D score among Black participants against zero (t = -5.79, df = 855); the paper prints the mean (-0.12, SD 0.60, N = 856) but not that t. The focal quantity is the mean D score (claim c221).
